verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, not a software product with user-manipulable items, so user-facing bulk operations across many items are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers memory, inference throughput, MIG partitioning and the bundled software stack, but nothing that amounts to a batch-operations feature for users. Hardware parallelism is a different axis and does not make this story applicable.
